item.g:product_type: Books > Parent Education > PDF ebook

g:structured_title.g:content: My Message Matters - Speech & Communication 101 - English PDF ebook

g:structured_description.g:content:
My Message Matters is the Speech & Communication 101 illustrated parent guide from Pinnacle Blooms Network, by Dr. Koti Reddy Saripalli and Dr. Sreeja Reddy Saripalli. Its 31 core pages explore everyday communication through gestures, sounds, words, pictures and established augmentative and alternative communication (AAC).
Explore familiar play, real choices, comfortable response time, shared books, family languages and useful messages such as help, stop, more and finished. The emphasis is on responding to meaning and keeping communication available, including established augmentative and alternative communication (AAC).
For parents and caregivers looking for speech and language support ideas to discuss and share in everyday routines, including families supporting a child with speech delay or different communication needs.
One separately readable English PDF ebook. Each PDF contains 45 file pages, including 31 core learning pages, nine shared PinnacleAI and Verify information pages, one discipline-specific service page, two covers and two blank pages. 101 is an introductory volume label, not a count of activities. Designed for parents, caregivers and educators selecting ideas to suit the child’s development, comfort, preferences and access. General educational information; the offer does not include therapy sessions, assessments or software access. The PDF edition is prepared. Online purchase and delivery are not yet available. Orders are closed.

g:structured_title.g:content: Understanding Everyday Behaviour - ABA Parent Education 101 - English PDF ebook

g:structured_description.g:content:
Understanding Everyday Behaviour is the ABA Parent Education 101 illustrated guide from Pinnacle Blooms Network, by Dr. Koti Reddy Saripalli and Dr. Sreeja Reddy Saripalli. Its 31 core pages help adults notice communication, comfort, choices and the surrounding situation before deciding how to respond.
Explore genuine choices, useful cues, manageable transitions, response time, supported breaks and ways to ask what would help. The pages welcome the child’s perspective and show practical ways to offer support without turning every moment into a test.
For parents and caregivers seeking a thoughtful introduction to supportive responses, everyday observations and manageable routines, including families supporting autistic children or children with different developmental needs.
